```{r}
#| echo: false
library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(glue)
cfg <- params$cfg
res <- params$results
```

## Data availability

```{r}
#| echo: false
tibble::tibble(
  dataset     = c("cases", "vectors", "environment",
                  "interventions", "resistance"),
  n_records   = c(nrow(res$cases), nrow(res$vectors),
                  nrow(res$environment),
                  nrow(res$interventions), nrow(res$resistance))
) |> gt::gt()
```

## Seasonal pattern

```{r}

res$fig_seasonal
```
